description: The whole match report: an overall score, a plain-language summary, a count of each outcome, and one card per requirement showing what the resume says and how it was judged.
alt: A match report showing a fit score of 72, a short summary, counts of each outcome, and cards for each requirement giving the assessment and the line from the resume it was judged against.

description: The match report narrowed to a single outcome by clicking one of the counts above it. Use this for anything about filtering, narrowing, or the outcome counts being clickable.
alt: A match report with the "3 partial" count selected. Only the three partially met requirements are shown, and the report reads "3 of 8 requirements" with a "Show all 8" link beside the counts.

description: The first step, empty and waiting for input: the panel where a job posting is added, by pasting the text, giving a link, or uploading a file. Use this for anything about how a posting gets into the app.
alt: A panel with three tabs — Paste Text, Link and File — on the Link tab, showing an empty address field above a "Load Job Description" button.

description: The confirmation strip shown once a posting has been loaded: what happened, the role it is for, and the way to replace it. Use this for anything about the loaded posting, the role heading, or editing either.
alt: A strip reading "Job description loaded" above its source and character count, with the role title beside it on two lines and a Replace button at the right.

description: The panel beside a loaded posting listing what the posting itself states: the pay range at display size, then setup, location, type, level, team, sponsorship, travel and dates, with anything the posting never said shown as "Not stated". Use this for anything about pay, salary, location, remote or hybrid policy, or reading a posting's terms without hunting through its paragraphs.
alt: A panel headed "At a glance" showing a pay range of $185k – $235k/yr with "plus equity + bonus" beneath it, then labelled rows for setup, location, type, level, team, sponsorship, travel, posted and apply-by, and a footnote saying the details were read from the posting.

description: The same panel with its pay row opened for correction: amount boxes, a currency and period picker, and a note field. Use this for anything about fixing, overriding or correcting a detail the app read off the posting wrongly.
alt: The "At a glance" panel with its pay row open for editing, showing two amount boxes reading 185000 and 235000, selectors for currency and period, a note field reading "plus equity + bonus", and Save and Cancel buttons.

description: One saved application as the applications rail draws it: company mark, role, the job's pay, setup and location as small chips, then its fit score and how far along it is. Use this for anything about the rail, switching between applications, or what a saved application shows at a glance.
alt: An application card showing a company initial tile beside the role "Staff Software Engineer, Payments Infrastructure" at Northwind, chips reading $185k – $235k/yr, Hybrid and San Francisco CA +1, and a 72/100 score beside the word Analyzed.

description: The empty resume upload panel, before any document has been chosen. Use this for anything about uploading, choosing, or replacing the resume file itself.
alt: An empty upload panel with a dashed drop zone reading "Drop your resume here or click to browse", noting that PDF, DOCX and TXT are supported.

description: A finished outreach email in its editor: a subject line above an editable body. Use this for anything about the generated letter, its wording, or editing it.
alt: An outreach email editor showing a generated subject line and a four-paragraph body addressed to a hiring manager, with formatting controls above the text.

description: A single claim the chat is proposing to record about the candidate, with Accept and Reject buttons and the reasoning behind it. Use this for anything about proposals, accepting or rejecting a suggested change, or recording a skill the resume does not mention.
alt: A proposal card offering to record that the candidate has worked with PostgreSQL, with the reason it was suggested and Accept and Reject buttons.
